title: Create a Django Project from Scratch
description: Set up a virtual environment, install Django, and create a new project named `first_project`.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

You’re starting a new Django project. Follow these steps to ensure everything is set up correctly:

1. Create a virtual environment named `myenv`.
2. Activate the environment.
3. Install Django.
4. Create a new Django project called `first_project`.
5. Run the development server and verify that the Django welcome page appears at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.

> **Hint**: The welcome page is the default page you see after running `runserver`.
hints: Use `python -m venv myenv` to create the virtual environment.
Activation commands differ on Windows and macOS/Linux. Check the lesson if you're unsure.
Navigate into the project folder and run `python manage.py runserver`.
expectedOutput: The server should start and show a message like `Starting development server at http://127.0.0.1:8000/`. In your browser you see the Django welcome page.
solutionCode:
# No single code solution – this is a procedural task.
# The following commands in order:

python -m venv myenv
# On Windows: myenv\Scripts\activate
# On macOS/Linux: source myenv/bin/activate
pip install django
django-admin startproject first_project
cd first_project
python manage.py runserver
